heading: The Nehemiah Rebuilds Bible Crossword
description: Solve a Nehemiah Bible crossword: the cupbearer’s request, the night ride round the walls, Sanballat’s mockery, and the sword and trowel. Free on iOS.
prose: A cupbearer in a Persian palace hears that the wall of Jerusalem is broken down and the gates burned, and asks for leave to go and build it. Nehemiah Rebuilds covers the first six chapters — the night ride round the ruins telling no one, the families assigned gate by gate, the mockery from outside, and the builders who worked with one hand and held a weapon with the other.
It's a Hard puzzle with a great deal of proper nouns, and it rewards reading the chapters first. The closing verse is Nehemiah's answer to the men who tried to stop him.

clues.text: The Horonite who mocked the building
What he came to build again

verseText: Then answered I them, and said unto them, The God of heaven, he will prosper us; therefore we his servants will arise and build: but ye have no portion, nor right, nor memorial, in Jerusalem.
